name: ob-pal
description: Turn any phone into a remote for 3D and on-screen navigation: gyro, trackpad and button trays over WebRTC.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/sw/tsconfig.json && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p extension/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: pnpm run test && pnpm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.pack:extension: pnpm run build:extension && pnpm --filter @obpal/extension run pack
scripts.e2e:extension: vite build && pnpm run build:extension && pnpm --filter @obpal/extension run e2e
scripts.bench:extension: vite build && pnpm run build:extension && node extension/scripts/bench.mjs
